controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the item/order under test
Same enemy hero, level, items, behaviour
title: Victor brawling three enemies
question: Does Victor survive and win a 1v3 face-to-face fight better on the spirit Aura Brawler core or the gun hybrid core?
hypothesis: Aura Brawler (Torment Pulse, Infuser) out-survives gun hybrid in 1v3 close fights; gun hybrid kills the first target faster.

enemies.hero: 3 different ranged/melee mix (e.g. Haze, Seven, Abrams)

procedure: Start 30m from enemies, all standing at spawn spots
Engage: Victor walks in and fights with normal rotation (1,2,3 as appropriate, ult when available)
Run until Victor dies, all enemies dead, or 40s

metrics.name: hp_lost_total
metrics.how: sum of damage taken incl. healed

decision.rule: arm B beats A on primary metrics with non-overlapping ranges
